quarterly_data.quarter: ASM International press release: ASM launches breakthrough Flowable Carbon technology for (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ASM launched XP8 Vertos Flowable Carbon, which the company says is the market's first plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD) flowable carbon film. It combines gap fill and planarization in a single PECVD process: the film fills high-aspect-ratio features from the bottom up without voids or seams and self-planarizes, which ASM says eliminates downstream chemical mechanical planarization or etch-back steps. ASM states it has initial deployment in high-volume manufacturing and applicability across both logic and memory devices (3D architectures). No customers, units or dollar figures stated.
